article.title: Meta Muse擴展至新加坡，購物與旅遊連接功能將逐步開放
article.title_en: Meta brings Muse to Singapore with phased shopping and travel connectors
article.summary: Meta在日期標示為10月27日的公告確認Muse已於新加坡提供iOS、Android及網頁版，並列出Shopee、Grab、Singapore Airlines、Klook等首批本地連接夥伴。
article.summary_en: In an announcement dated October 27, Meta confirmed Muse availability in Singapore on iOS, Android and the web, naming local connector partners including Shopee, Grab, Singapore Airlines and Klook.
article.why: 對面向東南亞消費者的零售及旅遊品牌，AI代理的比較、探索與預訂路徑值得納入渠道規劃，尤其要確認產品資料及服務條款能否被準確呈現。
article.why_en: Retail and travel brands serving Southeast Asia can assess agent-led comparison and booking journeys, including how product details and service terms appear.
article.next_step: 確認品牌是否已有合作平台連接，選一條旅遊或購物路徑檢視資料完整度、授權及確認步驟。
article.next_step_en: Check existing platform connections and review one shopping or travel journey for data completeness, authorization and confirmation steps.
highlights: Meta明言連接功能會逐步推出，部分體驗會在發布後提供。
用戶決定可存取的服務及資料；購買或寄送電郵等敏感動作前須確認。
highlights_en: Connector features roll out progressively, with some experiences arriving after launch.
Users control access to services and data; sensitive actions such as purchases or sending email require confirmation.
article.detail:
Meta在日期標示為10月27日的公告確認Muse已於新加坡提供iOS、Android及網頁版，並列出Shopee、Grab、Singapore Airlines、Klook等首批本地連接夥伴。

Meta明言連接功能會逐步推出，部分體驗會在發布後提供。

用戶決定可存取的服務及資料；購買或寄送電郵等敏感動作前須確認。

對面向東南亞消費者的零售及旅遊品牌，AI代理的比較、探索與預訂路徑值得納入渠道規劃，尤其要確認產品資料及服務條款能否被準確呈現。

確認品牌是否已有合作平台連接，選一條旅遊或購物路徑檢視資料完整度、授權及確認步驟。

官方頁面日期為10月27日，部分新加坡報道於28日刊出；本刊保留官方日期。此消息不代表香港已推出，亦不代表全部夥伴功能已可用。
article.detail_en:
In an announcement dated October 27, Meta confirmed Muse availability in Singapore on iOS, Android and the web, naming local connector partners including Shopee, Grab, Singapore Airlines and Klook.

Connector features roll out progressively, with some experiences arriving after launch.

Users control access to services and data; sensitive actions such as purchases or sending email require confirmation.

Retail and travel brands serving Southeast Asia can assess agent-led comparison and booking journeys, including how product details and service terms appear.

Check existing platform connections and review one shopping or travel journey for data completeness, authorization and confirmation steps.

The official page is dated October 27; some Singapore reports appeared October 28. This does not establish Hong Kong availability or that every partner feature is live.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
article.followup: 延續10月23日日本及Klook接入報道：本次新增新加坡市場及本地購物、旅遊夥伴；功能仍分階段推出。
article.followup_en: Following our October 23 Japan/Klook coverage, this adds Singapore and local shopping and travel partners; connector rollout remains phased.
